# Filter the dataframe to find the row with title "Robin Hood Play"
robin_hood_row = df[df['Title'] == 'Robin Hood Play']

# Get the season and series number of that episode
if not robin_hood_row.empty:
    season_num = robin_hood_row.iloc[0]['Season #']
    series_num = robin_hood_row.iloc[0]['Series #']
    
    # Find the episode in the same season with series number one less
    previous_episode = df[(df['Season #'] == season_num) & (df['Series #'] == series_num - 1)]
    
    if not previous_episode.empty:
        # Get the title of the previous episode
        answer = previous_episode.iloc[0]['Title']
    else:
        answer = None
else:
    answer = None
